title: WR Knox found negligent in crash, to pay $2.8M

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: WR Knox found negligent in crash, to pay $2.8M
sources.description: A Texas court on Wednesday issued a default judgment of more than $2.8 million against Theodore Knox, the co-defendant in one of the civil lawsuits against Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice stemming from a 2024 street racing crash in Dallas.
